content.short: xCall Service is a standardized interface that simplifies cross-chain development.
content.description: xCall Service empowers developers to broaden the reach of their dApps across multiple ecosystems from their preferred chains. It delivers seamless cross-chain connectivity by enabling contract calls to destination chains from source chains through a single standard that works across protocols. xCall Service is a lightweight contract that can extend across any protocol and will add support for new cross-chain messaging protocols as they emerge. This approach increases versatility while strengthening security through multiple protocol verifications.
content.meta: xCall Service provides a standardized interface to simplify cross-chain development. Discover xCall Service and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
